mapper.select: /* 후보정심사단어사전 자동 등록 - 완료건에 대한 수기등록 내용 조회 */ /* WordDictionaryRegBatchMapper.selectContentsToRegList */ SELECT I.INPT_SANCTION_NO AS INPT_SANCTION_NO ,C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD ,C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM ,C.AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM AS AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM ,UPPER(TRIM(I.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT)) AS ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT FROM CSPD001TM M ,CSPD004TF I ,CSPD112TI C WHERE M.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND I.INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND I.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' AND (TRIM(I.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(I.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT) NOT IN ('.','..','-','_','\')) AND (VSIZE(TRIM(I.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT)) < 100 AND VSIZE(TRIM(I.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT)) > 1) AND C.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(M.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, '1', '241', '242') --1:수입 AND C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = TO_CHAR(I.INPT_SANCTION_NO)
mapper.insert: /* 후보정심사단어사전 자동 등록 */ INSERT INTO CSPD117TI( AI_INPT_WORD_SRNO , AI_INPT_GRP_CD , AI_INPT_WORD_TXT , AI_INPT_WORD_INF_NM , AI_INPT_RMRK_TXT , TRN_LOG_SRNO , LST_DB_CHG_ID , LST_DB_CHG_DTM ) VALUES ( (SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_WORD_SRNO)+1 FROM CSPD117TI) , #{aiInptIntfItmNm} , #{itmInptHndgInpDatTxt} , null , null , #{trnLogSrno} , #{lstDbChgId} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))
